name: Matrix quantum mechanics
summary: Heisenberg, Born and Jordan built the first complete quantum mechanics, describing atoms by tables of measurable transitions instead of pictured electron orbits.
description: Observable transition quantities replace classical orbital descriptions in the matrix formulation developed by Heisenberg, Born and Jordan.
tier_reason: The formalism supports subsequent atomic, molecular and condensed-matter physics and quantum technologies over generations.

impact.note: The first complete quantum mechanics changed the understanding of matter; atomic, chemical and solid-state physics rest on it. Reach counts this formulation's users, physicists.

why: The older quantum theory of electron orbits failed to account for many measured atomic spectra.
